label: kizuna_botan_d_02
text: Welcome to my classroom. All the students here\nare in the STEM track, just like me.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_03
text: So, uh...there’s something I wanna talk to\nyou about.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_04
text: But not here. Let’s go somewhere we can talk\nin private.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_05
text: Th-this is my room. Make yourself at home.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_select_01
text: It’s nice and cozy in here

label: kizuna_botan_d_select_02
text: A little crowded, isn’t it?

label: kizuna_botan_d_06
text: Hehe. I know, right? Being surrounded by my\nVeevees and figurines is my kinda heaven![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_07
text: Wait, seriously? Is it the boxes from all my online\norders? Maybe I oughta get rid of ’em, huh...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_08
text: Anyway, you must be wondering why I brought\nyou here. It’s about my Team Star friends.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_09
text: They...they really mean the world to me. I love\nthem all so much that I got scared they weren’t\r\ngonna fit in OK or be happy at school.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_10
text: That’s why I’ve been sorta spying on them since\nthey came back.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_11
text: But it turns out I didn’t need to worry.\nThey’re already having a great time![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_12
text: And now I feel bad that I didn’t have it in me to\nbelieve in them in the first place...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_13
text:
They’ve all grown so much, but I haven’t changed
since Operation Starfall.\c
I’m still scheming up ways to fix things by myself
instead of having a little faith.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_select_03
text: It’s only natural you’d worry

label: kizuna_botan_d_select_04
text: You just need to believe in them!

label: kizuna_botan_d_14a
text: Y-you really think so? That’s a normal thing for\nfriends to do?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_14b
text: Y-yeah. I know. I promise I’ll try, but it might take\nme a little while to get there.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_15
text: Huh... I feel better after talking it out with you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]. Thanks.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_16
text: And, um, I want you to know you’re a really\nimportant friend to me, too.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_17a
text: That goes for Nemona as well! And even Arven\nand Koraidon![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_17b
text: That goes for Nemona as well! And even Arven\nand Miraidon![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_18
text: You know, I don’t normally like having people in\nmy room.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_19
text: But you’re an exception. Stop by for a chat\nor whatever anytime![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: kizuna_botan_d_20
text: Till our next confab, then! Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
